name: Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers
tagline: AnchorFix tool to eliminate air voids in resin
summary: Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers is a tool for filling deep and / or large diameter drilled holes by eliminating air voids. It is used with a Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube which is fixed onto the static mixer.
metaDescription: Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers is a tool for filling deep and / or large diameter drilled holes by eliminating air voids. It is used with a Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube which is fixed onto the static mixer.

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Resin stoppers are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 5 years from the date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.
